text:
elisa: Heads-up  two pilot customers ask for tenant-aware embeddings cache (per-tenant TTLs + eviction guarantees) as part of v1. Sales pushing this as a GA requirement. Need a fast tradeoff.

matt: Engineering: per-tenant cache policies touch runtime + cache sharding; estimate 2w infra + 3d validation. Increases test matrix and adds storage footprint.

doris: Product: embedding cache reduces token cost for retrieval use cases but is not required for basic inference. We could ship global cache with per-tenant namespacing later (v1.1).

kevin: Ops: supporting one-off tenant policy overrides manually is doable short-term for pilots but ops burden grows with customers. Need a runbook if we go pilot-only.

elisa: Proposed path: keep v1 scope minimal (global cache, no per-tenant SLAs). Offer an "embcache enterprise" add-on under SOW with guaranteed TTLs and eviction semantics. That keeps v1 on track and gives sales a commercial path.

matt: Agrees with add-on. If sales insists GA, expect ~1.5 week slip plus extra QA.

doris: UX/docs: we can add clear messaging in onboarding: "advanced cache policies available via enterprise add-on" and prepare migration notes.

ops-bot: Calendar: added "embcache add-on scoping" 2026-04-05 09:00 PT.

elisa: Quick vote: :thumbsup: keep v1 light + add-on SOW; :thumbsdown: fold into v1 and delay.

matt: :thumbsup:

doris: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup: (ops can support one pilot if needed)

elisa: Consensus: keep v1 and offer embcache enterprise SOW. Action items: matt RFC + estimate by EOD tomorrow; doris: onboarding blurb + migration note by Wed; kevin: runbook draft by Fri. I'll update milestone tracker after RFC. Thanks!
